title: Size of Variables

lines.explanation: Include the library for working with streaming data to and from the user
Add a reference to standard namespace that includes variables, types, constants, and functions
Open the body of the function
Declare the variable apple of the type long double (can hold a long decimal value)

lines.code: cout << "The size of an integer is " << sizeof(int) << " bytes.";
lines.explanation: Display the message with the size of the integer variables

lines.code: cout << "The size of a long integer is " << sizeof(long) << " bytes.";
lines.explanation: Display the message with the size of long integer variables

lines.code: cout << "An apple can be eaten in " << sizeof(apple);
lines.explanation: Display the size of the newly declared variable of the type long double (it has to be greater than the integer types because it has the decimal part)
main() is a function, so it should return a value. We make it 0, or in this case a dummy value
